column1: # Game profile of ESP Ra.De. Ψ (エスプレイドΨ, Switch, Japan only; update 1.4.1 = v327680 over the base game). Plays on the Mac (boot, attract, game mode menu, play into stage 2) with sound at 60 fps

# M2's engine (m2engage), SDK 7.4.0: it emulates Cave's 1998 arcade board in the NROs it loads from the RomFS's nro/ folder through nn::ro. Started from the provisional profile of build_ipa_from_nsp.py: the keys are its guesses, unchanged
# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie); the five NROs are found in the RomFS and loaded when the game asks
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region (it sets 3.14 GB)
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# used memory for the current rewritten modules, at least the default 64 MB
